question: Geoff and Trevor each roll a fair six-sided die.  What is the probability that the product of the numbers they roll is even?
solution:
The product is odd exactly when both rolls are odd. Each die has three odd faces (1, 3, 5) out of six. Since the rolls are independent, the probability of an odd product is \((3/6)^2=1/4\). The complementary probability of an even product is \(1-1/4=3/4\).
Final answer: \dfrac34
